content: If the parameter job - >jo bPrimitiveInfo - >primitiveInfo - >service is either set to CRY PTO_KEYSETVALID, CRYPTO_KEYSETINVALID, CRYPTO_RANDOMSEED, CRYPTO_KEYGENERATE, CRYPTO_KEYDERIVE, CRYPTO_KEYEXCHANGECALCPUBVAL or CRYPTO_KEYEXCHANGECALCSECRET , the parameters job - >jobPrimitiveInputOutput - >cryIfKeyId and, if applicable, j ob - >jobPrimitiveInput Output - >targetCryIfKey Id shall be checked if it is in valid range.
